author: blu
body: Aura-on-land tap effects. Wild Growth on a Forest: tapping the Forest yields its normal green plus one extra green (ramp). Psychic Venom on a Forest: tapping it still makes the green, but deals 2 damage to the land's controller. Both fire off the aura-tap hook in process-tap-mana, which scans the Auras attached to the tapped land after the mana is produced.
